body.x: SY Korea (CEO SangKyun Hyun) announced its participation in CES 2025 from January 7 to 10 in Las Vegas. The company will exhibit its innovative products at the K-Startup Pavilion.

Established in April 2020, SY Korea has rapidly gained traction in the automotive aftermarket sector with its proprietary brand, CARTON, which includes electric sprayers and other car care products. Achieving an annual growth rate exceeding 120%, the company has expanded beyond Korea to markets in Japan, Taiwan, and Germany.

In its fifth year, SY Korea continues its remarkable growth. It is preparing to unveil three new products at CES 2025: a second-generation electric sprayer, a foam sprayer, and a water stain remover. These innovations aim to solidify the company’s global expansion strategy.

Unveiled through crowdfunding in November, SY Korea’s latest products feature modular designs with detachable handles that house integrated batteries. Users can switch between three devices, ensuring versatility and convenience.

body.cap: CARTON brand's three new car wash products | Photo provided by SY Korea

body.x: The second-generation electric sprayer, used in the pre-wash phase, delivers a maximum pressure of 60 PSI, allowing for adjustable spray angles of 25°, 50°, or 80° with an additional nozzle attachment. The foam sprayer simplifies vehicle cleaning by instantly generating foam from water and detergent, eliminating the need for air compression. The water stain remover operates at a rapid 4,000 to 4,500 RPM, enabling quick and efficient removal of stains on car surfaces.

These products incorporate specialized sealing technology to prevent water penetration into internal PCBs, achieving IPX6 waterproof certification. Additional features include an ergonomic design for comfortable handling, dual 2,000mAh batteries for up to 60 minutes of continuous use, and USB Type-C charging compatibility.

An SY Korea representative stated, “We have already confirmed the high demand for our new products through domestic and international crowdfunding. CES 2025 will be a pivotal opportunity to accelerate sales growth and engage with potential aftermarket customers.” The representative also highlighted plans to establish overseas subsidiaries, ensuring market stability and expanding into more regions.

Targeting the largest markets in the world, the United States and China, SY Korea aims to intensify its global efforts. The company plans to develop tailored products reflecting car wash cultures in Europe and Southeast Asia, further broadening its distribution channels. “CES 2025 in Las Vegas will be a critical moment to gauge our potential in the North American market,” the representative emphasized.
